messages:
IncidentBot: PAGED: [P1] Hightide Logistics — dedicated pool canary failing in us-west-2. Elevated 5xx rate from canary group, 95th latency spike. Paging eng-oncall and eng-sre.
Aisha: on it. exact tenant id? impact summary? @Maria - heads up for customer comms.
Tomas: tenant `hightide-prod` hitting repeated `BadGateway` and `KVCache OOM` in runtime logs on nodes gp0-5..gp0-8. tracer shows async kernel OOM during kv restore.
Aisha: thanks. isolating canary now — diverting traffic to reserved fallback pool and quarantining tenant. running: ``redwood route set --tenant=hightide-prod --pool=reserved-fallback-usw2 --mode=immediate``
Devon: copying. I'll take ownership of the artifact revert; locking the change window. we should pin back to last stable artifact `hightide-20260308-rtv2`.
Tomas: agree. also set canary traffic=0 for the rollout group.
Devon: running pin+restart sequence, ETA ~8m. command: ``redwood artifact pin --tenant=hightide-prod --artifact=hightide-20260308-rtv2 --pool=dedicated-hgt-usw2``
Devon: logs:
```
> unpinning hightide-20260311-rc1
> pinning hightide-20260308-rtv2
> draining 4 canary replicas
> starting 4 stable replicas
> healthchecks passing
```
Maria - CSM: FYI I opened a bridge with Hightide (zoom + dial-in) and told them we're rolling their canary back and quarantining the tenant. they reported spikes on /shipments and /rates endpoints. sending note to account team.
Aisha: marking incident P1 since customer-visible and dedicated pool affected. Tomas you're incident lead — please own comms to eng/sre.
Tomas: monitoring metrics. after divert + pin, 5xx dropped from 12% -> 0.9% over the last 2 mins. latency 95th back to baseline. KV cache hit rate recovering.
IncidentBot: UPDATE: revert in progress; next escalation to eng-sre@pagerduty if errors >3% for 10m.
Devon: revert finished, pinned artifact is `hightide-20260308-rtv2`. canary disabled. running post-checks: checking KV cache warmup, kernel memory, connection pools.
Aisha: good. Maria — ask customer if they want an immediate full-pool rollback or prefer staged verification first. also capture any customer traffic patterns that might have triggered OOM.
Maria - CSM: customer asked to revert all dedicated nodes to the last stable (yes). scheduling full pool revert with maintenance window confirmation.
Tomas: prepping safe rollback runbook: steps include disabling concurrent deploys, run `redwood pool rollback --pool=dedicated-hgt-usw2 --artifact=hightide-20260308-rtv2`, validate health checks, then re-enable routing. snippet:
```
redwood pool rollback --pool=dedicated-hgt-usw2 --artifact=hightide-20260308-rtv2 --grace=300
redwood pool healthcheck --pool=dedicated-hgt-usw2 --wait=600
```
Devon: I'll execute the full pool revert after monitoring window (30m) and will gate on KV cache heat and steady error rate <1%. locking change.
Tomas: handing off to night oncall @Ravi at 22:00 UTC, leaving monitoring dashboard, runbook links, and current artifact pins in the incident doc.
Ravi: ack — I'll join the bridge and take over watch. add me to the pager escalation.
Aisha: closing immediate paging loop — mitigation worked (traffic diverted, pinned artifact, canary disabled). incident remains open for postmortem and full revert ops. next steps: RCA (KV cache sizing + kernel OOM mitigation), add canary safety check to block pin if memory regressions detected, customer retro. :white_check_mark:
